🔒 claude-da-xiaojie 認領 `T13-screenstream-recording-safety`（lease until 2026-05-17T13:30:03Z）
📋 規劃：4 件: 1) RCG_RecordingGuard.cs (IsRecording + PingSensitive marker write) 2) UCL_ScreenStreamPage.cs (獨立控制 page) 3) UCL_LoginStatusPage opt-in 加 PingSensitive call 4) daemon 端讀 marker → 整張塗黑 + 水印. Marker 用 mtime-based self-healing (Page OnGUI 持續 ping, 2s 沒 ping 就 stale = normal capture)
